description: Everything the console observes, plus the launcher that starts it. The observation hooks POST each event to the console on its default port through a curl one-liner that always exits 0, so a console that isn't running costs nothing but a discarded connection refusal instead of a hook-error notice on every tool call. A POST that finds nothing listening hands off to console-restart.sh, which brings the console back when a team is still live and stays silent either way. The launcher exits immediately unless a real team exists. Timeouts are in seconds.

hooks.command: curl -sS -m 5 -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary @- http://127.0.0.1:4823/hook 2>/dev/null || OCTO_PORT=4823 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/console-restart.sh"; exit 0
